Feed Tank 120K Disposable Vape: The Biggest Puff Vape We've Ever Made

Let's be real, most disposables sell you a big puff number and then die on flavour way before the battery or tank actually runs out. You know the feeling: halfway through and it already tastes burnt. The Feed Tank 120K disposable vape was built specifically so that doesn't happen. 30mL tank, up to 120,000 puffs, and tech that actually keeps it tasting good the whole way through, not just for the first day.

This is the official Feed Tank page, straight from FEED. If you've been searching for the biggest puff vape Canada has to offer, or just typed “120k puff vape” into Google to see what comes up, you're in the right spot.

What's Actually Inside the Feed Tank Vape

  • Up to 120,000 puffs, one of the highest puff counts on the market right now
  • 30mL of pre-filled e-liquid, no refills, no mess
  • 1000mAh battery, rechargeable over USB Type-C
  • 4 alternating mesh coils so flavour stays clean instead of turning harsh near the end
  • Adjustable airflow, tighten it up or open it wide, your call
  • Built-in screen showing exactly how much juice and battery you've got left
  • 20mg/mL nicotine salt across every flavour
  • 10 flavours to pick from

Is 120K Puffs Actually a Lot?

Short answer, yes. Most disposables on shelves right now sit somewhere between 5,000 and 25,000 puffs. At 120,000, the Feed Tank vape is genuinely one of the longest lasting vapes in Canada, not just on paper, but because the hardware is actually built to back the number up. A rechargeable battery plus a 30mL tank means you're not stuck with a dead device and juice still left inside, which is exactly what kills most “huge puff” vapes before they hit their real number.

Why It Doesn't Taste Burnt by the End?

Here's the part most big-puff vapes get wrong. They run one coil the entire time, and that coil wears out. By puff 15,000 it's already tasting thinner, sometimes straight up burnt. The Feed Tank 120K disposable vape rotates between 4 separate mesh coils instead of grinding down one. Each coil gets a breather while the others fire, so the flavour on puff 100,000 actually still tastes like the flavour on puff 1. That's the real reason this thing can claim 120K puffs and mean it.

Built Like a Vape That's Actually Meant to Last a Month

A big number means nothing if the battery taps out early. The Feed Tank's 1000mAh battery recharges over USB Type-C, so you're never left with unused juice and a dead device, a real problem with older high-puff disposables that weren't rechargeable at all. The built-in screen means you always know where your battery and e-liquid actually stand, no more guessing, no more shaking it to check.

Backed Direct: 30-Day Warranty From FEED

Every Feed Tank 120K disposable vape bought on feedvapor.com comes with FEED's own 30-day warranty against defects in material and craftsmanship. You're dealing with us directly if something's actually wrong, not bouncing between a reseller and a manufacturer trying to figure out who's responsible.
